attempted_claim: Let (P,sigma) be the positron Mazur cork with boundary involution sigma, embedded in Z0=CP2#-CP2 by the fixed nucleus Kirby embedding with simply-connected complement. Let Z1=Z0#(S2xS2) by internal stabilization disjoint from P and F:Z1->Z1 the stabilized cork-twist diffeomorphism (twist by sigma inside P, identity across the S2xS2 neck). Then F is topologically isotopic to the identity rel boundary but not smoothly so: the mod-2 S1-families Seiberg-Witten invariant of its mapping torus E_F in the fixed spin-c structure s#t0 is nonzero, and the S1/Pin(2) family Bauer-Furuta class BF(F) is nontrivial where defined — so (P,sigma) is a strong cork with one-stabilization survival number >=1.
